title: simfleet / Workers
description: Job throughput, outcomes and duration, and the Kafka consumer side of the workers.

list.name: job
list.label: Prometheus job
list.description: The job label of the scrape config. Change it when the scrape config names jobs differently, e.g. under kube-prometheus-stack.

panels.title: Workers up
panels.description: Scrape targets answering. Static targets that are not running count as down.

panels.title: Success
panels.description: Successes over all deliveries that did work, over the selected range. Skipped deliveries (duplicates absorbed by Claim) are left out.

targets.expr: sum(rate(simfleet_jobs_total{job=~"$job", runner=~"$runner", instance=~"$instance", outcome="success"}[$__range])) / sum(rate(simfleet_jobs_total{job=~"$job", runner=~"$runner", instance=~"$instance", outcome!="skipped"}[$__range]))

panels.title: p95 duration
panels.description: Per runner, over the selected range. Runs faster than 100µs all land in the first bucket.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, runner) (rate(simfleet_job_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", runner=~"$runner", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Partitions
panels.description: Should equal the topic's partition count once the group is stable.

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: Deliveries whose claim or state write failed, over the selected range. The job waits for lease expiry or redelivery.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Restarts of a process at the same address. A Kubernetes pod comes back as a new instance, so count those with kube-state-metrics instead.

panels.title: Deliveries by outcome (jobs/s)
panels.description: Every delivery ends in exactly one outcome. success: result saved. retried: back in the queue. failed: no attempts left or a permanent error. fenced: the job moved on without this attempt. error: claim or write failed. skipped: a duplicate delivery.

panels.title: Completed per worker (jobs/s)
panels.description: Workers draining at very different rates point to uneven partition assignment.

panels.title: Records consumed per worker (records/s)
panels.description: Records fetched from Kafka. Runs ahead of completed jobs by up to the worker's buffer.

panels.title: Backlog (served by the controller)
panels.description: Jobs queued counts jobs; consumer lag counts records. They differ by duplicates and requeues still in Kafka. Lag is absent until a worker joins the group.

panels.title: Job duration
panels.description: Time inside Runner.Run, failed runs included. The top bucket ends at about 52s, above the 30s runner timeout.

panels.title: Job duration distribution
panels.description: Runs per duration bucket over time. Darker means more runs.

panels.title: Consumer lag by partition (now)
panels.description: Records not yet committed, per partition. One tall bar while the rest are empty is a slow or dead worker pinning its partitions. Served by the controller.

panels.title: Commit failures and malformed records (per min)
panels.description: A failed commit is retried on the next tick. A malformed record is skipped for good.

panels.title: Deliveries that did not succeed (per min)
Fenced writes and exhausted attempts (per min)
panels.description: Worker side only. Fenced: a sustained rise means leases are shorter than real job duration. Exhausted: the job's last attempt failed here.

panels.title: Resident memory
panels.description: What a container memory limit counts. GOMEMLIMIT belongs at ~90% of that limit.
